doi_tuong: dấu hiệu khởi phát LAST, hệ thần kinh trung ương (CNS)
dieu_kien: bệnh nhân còn tỉnh táo, ngộ độc hấp thu toàn thân
trich_nguyen_van: The CNS is more sensitive than the heart to the toxic effects of local anaesthetics, and CNS symptoms and signs usually present !rst. These include cir-cumoral paraesthesia, facial numbness, tingling of the tongue, dizziness, metallic taste and tinnitus. Restlessness, slurred speech and tremors may develop, followed by generalised convulsions, coma and respiratory arrest.
